name: Brook
direction: Clear forward alto; light Mexican Spanish accent; smooth vowels and measured certainty.
description: An adult woman with a clear, forward-resonant alto and a light Mexican Spanish accent in fluent English. Smooth sustained vowels, crisp consonants, and a measured even rhythm. Bright focused resonance, a composed friendly manner, and firm sentence endings. Her warmth comes through careful attention and understated humour. Natural conversational English. Clean studio recording.
text: The road is quiet this morning. Come inside, and tell me where you are going. We can find a place for your horses.
